browser_plugin_description: Shows a live web page beside a conversation, which you and agents use in turn to visit websites and fill in forms. Needs Windows.
browser_start_failed: Mannie could not start the Browser plugin. Turn it off and on from the Plugins page.
browser_failure_unsupported_platform: Browser needs Windows, where Mannie shows web pages with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime. It is not available on this system yet.
browser_off_question: Turning off Browser ends all browser sessions and clears their sign-ins.
browser_empty_description: Open a browser to browse yourself, or ask the agent to visit a site.
browser_end_description: This closes its tabs and clears its sign-ins.
browser_no_tab: Open a tab to visit a website.
browser_still_label: Picture of the web page, shown while a menu or dialog is open
browser_activity_click: The agent clicked on the page.
browser_activity_fill: The agent filled in a field.
browser_focus_keyboard: Press F6 to move between the page and Mannie.
browser_settings_description: Manage trusted hosts and saved site credentials.
browser_credentials_description: Save passwords or codes for a site. Approve each credential before an agent can use it in a conversation.
browser_credential_empty_description: Save a password or code for an agent to enter on a site with your approval.
browser_credential_site_description: Include the scheme and any port, such as https://example.com or http://localhost:3000.
browser_credential_label_description: Use a name the agent can recognize, such as Account password.
browser_credential_value_description: The agent can enter this value only at the specified site after you approve the site and the credential.
browser_certificate_description: Trust a self-signed certificate for the hostname you enter, on all HTTPS ports. Saved trust applies to every Browser session on this Mannie installation, including after a restart.
browser_certificate_hostname_description: Enter a hostname or IP address such as 127.0.0.1. Leave out the scheme, port, and path.
browser_certificate_fingerprint_descript: Get the server certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint from the site administrator or your server configuration. Enter its hexadecimal digits.
browser_certificate_trust_saved: Certificate trust saved. Try the address again.
browser_certificate_empty_description: Add a host to trust its self-signed HTTPS certificate.
browser_certificate_forget_description: This closes any Browser sessions that allowed this certificate.
browser_error_ipc: Mannie could not reach the browser service. Retry or reopen the Browser pane.
browser_error_off: Browser is turned off. Turn it on from the Plugins page.
browser_error_missing: Mannie could not find the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime. Install it from Microsoft, then start the session again.
browser_error_incompatible: Mannie could not use the installed WebView2 runtime. Update it, then start the session again.
browser_error_disconnected: The browser stopped responding. Start a new session to continue.
browser_error_uncertain: The browser may have received the action. Check the page before trying again.
browser_error_session_missing: This browser session has ended. Start a new session to continue.
browser_error_owner_control: The agent is paused while you have control.
browser_error_agent_control: Take over before interacting with the page.
browser_error_navigation_denied: Navigation was blocked. Check the address or choose another site.
browser_error_certificate_rejected: Browser could not verify this site's certificate. For a self-signed site, open Settings > Browser, save its verified fingerprint, and try the address again.
browser_error_certificate_expired: A trusted certificate was about to expire, so Browser ended this session. Start a new session to continue.
browser_error_certificate_store_failed: Mannie could not access saved certificates. Try again.
browser_error_certificate_saved_conflict: A different certificate is saved for this hostname. Forget it before trusting a replacement.
browser_error_certificate_revocation_fai: Mannie could not close every session affected by this certificate. Try forgetting it again.
browser_error_certificate_revoked: Browser ended this session because you removed a certificate it trusted. Start a new session to continue.
browser_error_unsupported_prompt: The site opened a browser prompt that Mannie cannot handle. Use the site's web form when available.
browser_error_stale_target: The page changed before the action. Wait for the current view and try again.
browser_error_invalid_input: Mannie could not use that browser input. Check the address or field and try again.
browser_error_not_found: The browser item is gone. Check the current view and try again.
browser_error_credential_missing: The credential is unavailable for this site. Check the site credentials in Browser Settings.
browser_error_credential_store_unavailab: Mannie could not access the operating system credential store. Check that it is available and try again.
browser_error_credential_catalog_failed: Mannie could not access the saved credential list. Try again.
browser_error_credential_already_exists: This site already has a credential with that label. Use another label or remove the existing credential.
browser_error_session_credentials_retire: Manage site credentials in Browser Settings.
browser_error_limit: This browser session reached its tab limit. End the session to open a fresh one.
